error.FORBIDDEN: Your role cannot change placement. Owners and admins set it; instructors may revoke an exemption.
error.STALE_REVISION: These settings or this enrollment changed since you opened them. Refresh and try again.
error.PLACEMENT_LIMIT_LOOSENS_AUTHOR: The question limit can only be lowered below what the course author allows.
error.PLACEMENT_NOT_OFFERED: No published release of this course offers placement, so there is no question limit to set. Leave it empty.
error.PLACEMENT_EXEMPTION_NOT_FOUND: That exemption no longer exists. Refresh.
error.INVALID_REQUEST: Check the values: the reason needs at least 10 characters.
error.unavailable: Placement administration is unavailable. Nothing changed.
error.PLACEMENT_RETESTS_LOOSEN_AUTHOR: The course author allows fewer runs per learner. Lower the number of runs.
error.PLACEMENT_COOLDOWN_LOOSENS_AUTHOR: The course author asks for a longer wait between runs. Raise the hours before a retest.
error.PLACEMENT_EVIDENCE_LOOSENS_AUTHOR: The course author asks for more kinds of question per lesson. Raise the number, or leave it empty to use the author's.
error.PLACEMENT_ITEM_NOT_IN_BLUEPRINT: One of the questions is no longer in the author's placement questions. Refresh and choose again.
error.PLACEMENT_OBJECTIVE_NOT_PLACEABLE: One of the objectives is no longer one the author lets learners place out of. Refresh and choose again.
error.PLACEMENT_EPISODE_UNKNOWN: One of the lessons no longer exists in the active release, or the author already protects it. Refresh and choose again.
